description.value: Yayu is a 100% plant-based cafe tucked into Ucluelet's downtown, serving consciously crafted specialty coffee drinks, smoothies, and nourishing bowls and wraps on the traditional territory of the Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ Nation. The cafe offers both outdoor patio seating overlooking Fraser Lane and limited indoor seating, with takeout also available. Owner Maude brings a background in wildlife management and culinary experience to a menu that skews toward whole-food, globally inspired dishes with many gluten-free options.
